user_feedback: HUD absent/ineffective in the delivered scene.
Phone reads as a handoff rather than a reflex catch; needs deliberate sound design.
Wheeled cart does not demonstrate strength; replace with a large solid object such as a rock.
Overhead train lies at 90 degrees to the rails and faces Riley.
Every scene should not be in the station; redesign across different locations.

powers_startframe_motion.review_summary: HUD route lock, permanently buckled steel and actual forward sprint visible. Phone initially rises and catch is too slow. Train geometry/direction fixed, but runner drifts inward and lacks a clear winning lead.
